326.reason: no keys: the package takes and generates no key material; operands are byte strings to compress and compressed streams, not key bytes of a fixed strength

327.reason: lossless compression: package implements LZW compression and decompression only, no cipher, hash or MAC

407.reason: bounded work per call: the encoder performs one dictionary lookup per input byte and the decoder writes each delivered byte once, through a dictionary of at most 65,536 fixed-size entries, delivering at most the documented output cap; no other input-dependent iteration
